description: The bar chart illustrates the ratio (in percent) for three language models across three knowledge domains, showing side-by-side comparisons of Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT within each domain. The horizontal axis contains the categorical domains “Movies,” “Songs,” and “Basketball,” arranged left to right in that order, while the vertical axis is labeled “Ratio (%)” and uses a linear scale spanning roughly 50 to 90 with evenly spaced tick marks at 10-point intervals (50, 60, 70, 80, 90). Each category displays a grouped set of three bars: for Movies, Llama3 is shown in blue at about 90%, Qwen2 in red at about 90% (slightly above the blue bar), and ChatGPT in yellow at about 73%; for Songs, Llama3 (blue) is about 84%, Qwen2 (red) is about 90%, and ChatGPT (yellow) is about 62–63%; for Basketball, Llama3 (blue) is about 66–67%, Qwen2 (red) is about 57–58%, and ChatGPT (yellow) is about 61–62%. The legend at the top maps colors to models (blue=Llama3, red=Qwen2, yellow=ChatGPT), the bars are grouped by domain rather than sorted by height, and there are no visible annotations or special emphasis beyond the color coding.
